title: shroom — Record. Share. Pay-as-you-go.
excerpt: Screen recordings that live in your own Cloudflare account. No account with us, no subscription.
content_html:
shroom

curl -fsSL https://shroom.am/install | sh

brew install --cask bagrat/shroom/shroom && open ~/Applications/shroom.app

Install shroom on my Mac: read https://shroom.am/agent and follow it.

Read it firstRead it first Your agent asks you before it runs anything.For macOS 14 or newer, Apple silicon.

What would it cost?

$0.00 a month

1 hour

Auto-cleanup after

A team of 20, an hour each a month: $0.85 with 30-day cleanup, $11.85 kept a year.

Why shroom?

  • Your videos live in your own Cloudflare account
  • You pay only Cloudflare, for the storage
  • Invite your team with a link
  • No price per person — the bill counts video, not people
  • Old videos clean themselves up. Pin the ones you keep.
  • About ten minutes of guided setup, once
  • Open source — every line on GitHub

For companies · coming soon

Company sign-in

Teams already work for free: you invite each person with a link, and remove them by hand when they leave. Company sign-in does both for you.

  • No invites. Your team signs in with their Google Workspace account, and they’re in.
  • Leavers are out on their own. Remove someone’s Google account, and their shroom access ends with it.
  • Videos only your company can watch. Mark a video so it opens only for people signed in with your company’s Google account.
  • Still your own Cloudflare. Your videos never pass through us.

$59 a month per space, any number of people

Early price. Nothing to pay until it’s ready.

Want it for your team? Write to hi@shroom.am, and we’ll tell you when it’s ready.
